kind: Proposed acceptance of the implemented local study; no publication or 9/10 certification.
scope: Native SVG V5 character and 27 performances: 24 emotions plus three separate studies.
Portrait signature study with owner-selected Investigate & share.
Current avatar/header exports and two deterministic 30fps films.
Keyboard, control, mobile CSS and accessible-description improvements.
proposedDecision: Accept the implemented local foundation for continued design and future website work with named limits. Keep individual scores; do not claim9/10 across the board.
implemented: Tiny innocent anatomy preserved; day and night use identical geometry and numeric poses.
Warm investigation/share lead follows a verified eva.md question; original curiosity and wry alternatives remain.
Curious entry, surprise response and hop contact timing refined; one-peek audition stays separate from the original mischievous emotion.
Night antenna highlight quieted and broad material shading softened; original rim retained.
Phone portrait staging gives the existing character more space; 320px heading wrapping corrected.
Global reading keys freed; offscreen collection wait cancelled; native control behavior retained; reduced-motion status truthful.
Accessible descriptions match each performance. Hover follows capability, coarse-pointer fields use 16px text, and UI press feedback has explicit brief timing.
unresolvedCraft: Mitten, ruff and glasses details remain dense at 96–128px. The sharing hand is visible, but its invitational meaning is less specific than the face and glasses.
Small night-avatar antenna connections remain weaker than day. Use day as the universal 32px mark; night needs more room.
The wry afterthought and isolated mischievous still remain subtle. Their temporal reading needs observation.
The project question is a credible authorship bridge. A deeper verified story about a decision and its result belongs in the future website.
Phone portrait staging prioritizes legibility with more vertical height; the first viewport does not show every control and the complete character.
The authored screen-right investigation glance is less literally aligned with the question in the stacked phone composition. Better visibility does not mean this spatial relation is fully resolved.
evidence: Fifteen deterministic motion tests pass; all 27 performances sampled at 60fps.
567 browser geometry samples across frozen, day and night match.
Exact 30fps films and decoded frame sheets are available. Sampled stills do not prove continuous motion perception.
Browser control, description, reduced-motion and responsive-check records are available.
Focused active Thinking sample: 119 intervals, mean 34.45ms, p95 35ms, max 67ms, four above 50ms. Mixed idle/playback one-second gaps have not been attributed to SVG cost.
validationLimits: No new unfamiliar-human emotion comprehension, personal attribution, attachment or delayed-recall results.
No subjective continuous-motion certification from sampled frames.
No physical-phone or GPU performance validation; measured cadence is local desktop evidence only.
Native OS menu keyboard commit and spoken screen-reader output remain unverified.
No public GitHub changes, remote commit/push or deployment.
Emotion labels and explanatory copy prime the intended interpretation. Any future comprehension study needs neutral prompts and recorded viewport/scroll exposure.
skillWorkflow: All 18 specialists inspect the 17 installed catalog entries and read relevant skills in full; preserve actual intake in each record.
Each pair settles practical skill use and exceptions. Future engineers inherit AGENTS.md and brand/workflow.json.
Character acting is intentional content. Apply UI budgets, keyboard-feedback rules and GPU guidance by purpose rather than mechanically.
Evidence and meaningful scores cannot be replaced by checklists or consensus.

pairRecommendations.brand: Keep the warm owner-selected signature and real project bridge. Deepen verified authorship later; avoid audience-impact claims.
pairRecommendations.performance: Keep the improved beat structure. A bounded future study can vary tiny hand pose and orientation to strengthen invitation without changing anatomy. Continuous playback evidence is needed for timing judgments.
pairRecommendations.identity: Keep the current identity and matched themes. Use the day universal avatar and give night more room. Final portrait and 320px wrapping supersede old phone criticisms.
pairRecommendations.rigging: Accept the intact constrained rig and static exports with explicit contact-density and live-cadence limits. Do not attribute mixed idle one-second gaps to SVG without evidence.
pairRecommendations.interaction: Accept the native controls and v4 semantics for the local study. The report link must resolve. Native keyboard, spoken AT and phone validation remain separate.
pairRecommendations.audience: Keep hypotheses separate from owner preference and expert craft. Audience outcomes remain unscored; authoring labels are not neutral research stimuli.
pairRecommendations.storyboard: Keep Investigate & share as the lead and the one-peek audition as an alternative. Continue challenging hand specificity, comic rhythm and the phone eyeline-to-question relation within the same anatomy.
pairRecommendations.visual: Keep the refined night paint and identical geometry. Material polish does not resolve hand-contour density.
pairRecommendations.sound: Keep motion silent and self-contained. Optional future audio should reinforce an already readable visual cause, never mask the unresolved phone eyeline relation.

reviewProtocol: Each reviewer reads the partner independent record and this same proposal, then writes a substantive pair response and explicit individual vote. Resolve objections with both reviewers before claiming consensus; silence is not agreement.
supersedes: team-proposal-v1.json; adds independently identified phone eyeline limitation before any votes.
